Dear KeHE Deductions,

This is to inform you that claim R-0000268, taken on 2014-11-07, for $211.68, is pending due to the absence of an agreement on file. The shelf price dropped as part of a promotion, and we require the promotion agreement for this store, item, and period before making a decision. Please provide the necessary document by the dispute deadline of 2015-05-06.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Sincerely,
Northfield Pantry Co.
